newsitem.title: HONG KONG: ABC offers new financial paging service.
newsitem.headline: ABC offers new financial paging service.

text.p: Paging services provider ABC Communications (Holdings) Ltd said on Tuesday it would launch a new paging system, specifically designed to provide high speed transmission of financial market data.

The new real-time financial information dissemination system, QuickSilver, was designed for foreign exchange dealers, stock brokers, fund managers and individual investors, the company said in a statement.
The system provided real-time quotations and analysis on markets from information providers such as the Hong Kong stock exchange, the Hong Kong futures exchange and Reuters, the company said.
ABC Communications' shares closed HK$0.035 lower at HK$1.99 on Tuesday. -- Hong Kong Newsroom (852) 2843 6370
